I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from the incident channel, which he's a member of. On 3 Sep 2025 Pree posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 the same day she posted that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I told him the channel doesn't give a city or address for Southgate, and that Pree or Hollis would know more. I didn't use material he can't see, like Pree's email about the root cause, which mentions the Tulsa yard. That email also describes a gate check-in outage, so it may not be the same incident.
